$schema-comment: Wave 6a Task 1 bundle budgets. Sizes in BYTES (gzipped). Edited via PR with rationale per docs/operations/bundle-budget.md.

rules.label: main entry
rules.rationale: Redesign: 131.1 KB after the Lightning-class chrome (TopBar/SideNav/navigation) plus expanded mock-client seeds & RPC handlers, which ship in main because supabaseClient imports the mock statically. 140 KB cap leaves ~9 KB for remaining phases; follow-ups: dynamic-import the mock client and route-split chart-vendor, then tighten. +100 B (fix #64): the strict PGRST201 practice_slots embed check in the mock, which ships in main for the reason above; measured 136.55 -> 136.76 KB after two compaction passes.

rules.label: main css
rules.rationale: Redesign ships the Lightning-class design system (light+dark tokens + chrome/grid/page component CSS) in the main stylesheet: 21.7 KB after Phase 1. 30 KB cap leaves ~8 KB for the remaining redesign phases; revisit after Phase 9.

rules.label: chart vendor
rules.rationale: Current 119.92 KB; 130 KB cap. F-4-02 follow-up (route-split) targets <50 KB; tighten then.

rules.label: supabase vendor
rules.rationale: Current 49.93 KB; 60 KB cap absorbs minor SDK growth.

rules.label: react vendor
rules.rationale: Current 17.41 KB; 25 KB cap absorbs React 19.x patch growth.

rules.label: images (any png)
rules.rationale: F-4-03 resolved by the redesign rebrand: SL-Logo assets are quantized PNGs ≤ 15 KB. 100 KB cap guards against future unoptimized image additions.

rules.label: fonts (woff2)
rules.rationale: Self-hosted Public Sans variable fonts (CSP font-src 'self'): upright 27 KB + italic 28 KB, latin subset. Cap 35 KB per file; woff2 is already compressed so raw bytes are gated.

totalFirstPaintRationale: Sum of main + react-vendor + supabase-vendor + main-css gzip. Current ~201 KB; cap 250 KB.
